en.s: The Jinshin War (壬申の乱, jinshin no ran) was a war of succession that took place in the Yamato Kingship near the end of Asuka period. It broke out in 672 following the death of Emperor Tenji. The name refers to the jinshin (Ch. renshen 壬申) or ninth year of the sexagenary cycle, corresponding to the Gregorian year 672. It was one of the largest conflicts in classical Japanese history.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 壬申之乱（日文：壬申の乱，jinshin no ran）是飞鸟时代末期大和王权内部的一场继承战争。天智天皇去世后，战争于672年爆发。“壬申”指干支纪年中的壬申年，对应公元672年。这是日本古代史上规模最大的冲突之一。

en.s: The Battle of Yancheng (simplified Chinese: 郾城之战; traditional Chinese: 郾城之戰) took place in 1140 near modern-day Luohe City in Henan Province, China between the main armies of China under the Song dynasty and the Jurchen Jin invaders from the north. The battle was a major clash in the wars between the Jin Empire and China. The Chinese forces, under the leadership of General Yue Fei, won a decisive victory despite being outnumbered.
en.n: Song dynasty general Yue Fei defeats an army led by Jin dynasty general Wuzhu at the Battle of Yancheng during the Jin–Song Wars.

zh.s: 1140年，宋朝军队与从北方入侵的女真人金军在中国河南省今漯河市附近交战。这是金与宋之间战争中的一场重要战役。尽管兵力较少，岳飞将军率领的宋军仍取得决定性胜利。
zh.n: 宋朝将领岳飞在金宋战争期间于郾城之战中击败金朝将领兀术率领的军队。

en.s: The Battle of the Blacks or Battle of the Slaves was a conflict in Cairo that occurred during the Rise of Saladin in Egypt, on 21–23 August 1169, between the black African units of the Fatimid army and other pro-Fatimid elements, and Sunni Syrian troops loyal to the Fatimid vizier, Saladin.

zh.s: 1169年8月21日至23日，埃及萨拉丁崛起期间，开罗发生冲突。法蒂玛军队中的黑人非洲部队及其他亲法蒂玛势力，与效忠法蒂玛维齐尔萨拉丁的逊尼派叙利亚军队交战。这场冲突也称为“奴隶之战”。

en.s: The Battle of Örlygsstaðir was a historic battle fought by the Sturlungar against the Ásbirningar and the Haukdælir clans in northern Iceland. The battle was part of the civil war that was taking place in Iceland at the time between various powerful clans during the time known as the Age of the Sturlungs. The Battle of Örlygsstaðir was fought on 21 August 1238 between Sighvatur Sturluson (brother of Snorri Sturluson) and his son Sturla Sighvatsson on the one hand, and Kolbeinn ungi and Gissur Þorvaldsson (later Earl Gissur) on the other. Sighvatur had nearly 500 men but there no evidence available of the size of Sturla's following.

zh.t: 厄尔利格斯塔迪尔战役
zh.s: 这场历史性战役发生在冰岛北部，斯图伦格家族与阿斯比宁家族、豪克达尔家族交战。战役是当时冰岛内战的一部分，当时各个强大家族正在争夺权力，这一时期被称为“斯图伦格时代”。1238年8月21日，西格瓦图尔·斯图鲁松（斯诺里·斯图鲁松的兄弟）和他的儿子斯图拉·西格瓦图松，与年轻的科尔贝因和吉苏尔·托尔瓦尔德松（后来的吉苏尔伯爵）交战。西格瓦图尔有近500名士兵，但没有证据表明斯图拉所率部队的规模。

en.t: King Stefan Uroš III, after months of anarchy, surrenders to his son and rival Stefan Dušan, who succeeds as King of Serbia
en.s: Stefan Uroš III (c. 1276 – 11 November 1331), was King of Serbia from 6 January 1322 to 8 September 1331. Dečanski was the son of King Stefan Milutin (d. 1321). He defeated two other contenders to the Serbian throne. Stefan is known as Dečanski after the great monastery of Visoki Dečani he built.

zh.t: 经历数月无政府状态后，斯特凡·乌罗什三世国王向其子兼对手斯特凡·杜尚投降，后者继位为塞尔维亚国王
zh.s: 斯特凡·乌罗什三世（约1276年—1331年11月11日）于1322年1月6日至1331年9月8日担任塞尔维亚国王。德昌斯基是国王斯特凡·米卢廷（卒于1321年）之子。他击败了另外两名塞尔维亚王位竞争者。斯特凡因建造维索基德查尼修道院而获称“德昌斯基”。

en.t: Henry the Navigator leads Portuguese forces to victory over the Marinids at the Conquest of Ceuta
en.s: Prince Henry the Navigator (4 March 1394 – 13 December 1460), was a Portuguese prince, a central figure in the early days of the Portuguese Empire and often credited as one of the main initiators of the Age of Discovery. Henry was the third child of King John I of Portugal, who founded the House of Aviz.

zh.t: 航海家亨利亲王率领葡萄牙军队在征服休达战役中击败马林王朝
zh.s: 航海家亨利亲王（1394年3月4日—1460年12月13日）是葡萄牙王子，是葡萄牙帝国早期历史中的关键人物，常被认为是大航海时代的主要推动者之一。亨利是葡萄牙国王若昂一世的第三个孩子；若昂一世创建了阿维斯王朝。

en.s: Portuguese forces under the command of King John I conquered the North African city of Ceuta from the Marinid Sultanate on 21 August 1415. The city's defenses fell under Portuguese control after a carefully prepared attack, and the successful capture of the city marked the beginning of the Portuguese Empire. Ceuta remained under Portuguese control until it was transferred to Spain in 1668.

zh.s: 1415年8月21日，若昂一世国王率领的葡萄牙军队从马林王朝手中攻占北非城市休达。经过周密准备的进攻后，葡萄牙军队突破了城防。这次成功占领标志着葡萄牙帝国的开端。休达由葡萄牙控制，直到1668年转交给西班牙。

en.s: The siege of Buda (4 May – 21 August 1541) ended with the capture of the city of Buda, the historical capital of the Kingdom of Hungary, by the Ottoman Empire, leading to about 150 years of Ottoman rule in parts of Hungary. The siege, part of the Little War in Hungary, was one of the most important Ottoman victories over the Habsburg monarchy during Ottoman–Habsburg wars (16th to 18th century) in Hungary and the Balkans.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1541年5月4日至8月21日的布达围城战以奥斯曼帝国攻占匈牙利王国历史首都布达告终，此后奥斯曼帝国统治匈牙利部分地区约150年。这场围城战属于匈牙利小战争，是16至18世纪奥斯曼—哈布斯堡战争期间，奥斯曼帝国在匈牙利和巴尔干地区战胜哈布斯堡王朝的重要战役之一。

en.s: The Pueblo Revolt of 1680, also known as Popé's Rebellion or Po'pay's Rebellion, was an uprising of most of the Indigenous Pueblo people against the Spanish colonists in the province of Santa Fe de Nuevo México, larger than present-day New Mexico. Persistent Spanish policies, coupled with incidents of brutality and cruelty such as those that occurred in 1599 and resulted in the Ácoma Massacre, stoked animosity and gave rise to the eventual Revolt of 1680.
en.n: Pueblo Indians capture Santa Fe from the Spanish during the Pueblo Revolt.

zh.s: 1680年普韦布洛起义又称波佩起义或波帕伊起义，是大多数原住民普韦布洛人反抗西班牙殖民者的起义，发生在圣菲新墨西哥省（范围大于今新墨西哥州）。西班牙长期推行的政策，加上1599年发生的暴行和残酷事件（导致阿科马大屠杀），激起了当地人的敌意，最终引发1680年的起义。
zh.n: 普韦布洛人在起义期间从西班牙人手中夺取圣菲。

en.s: The Battle of Dunkeld (Scottish Gaelic: Blàr Dhùn Chaillinn) was fought between Jacobite clans supporting the deposed king James VII of Scotland and a government regiment of covenanters supporting William of Orange, King of Scotland, in the streets around Dunkeld Cathedral, Dunkeld, Scotland, on 21 August 1689 and formed part of the Jacobite rising commonly called Dundee's rising in Scotland. The battlefield is currently under research to be inventoried and protected by Historic Scotland under the Scottish Historical Environment Policy of 2009.

zh.s: 1689年8月21日，支持被废黜的苏格兰国王詹姆斯七世的雅各派部族，与支持奥兰治的威廉（苏格兰国王）的政府军圣约派团在苏格兰邓凯尔德大教堂周边街道交战。这场战斗是苏格兰雅各派起义的一部分，该起义通常称为邓迪起义。目前，历史苏格兰机构正依据2009年《苏格兰历史环境政策》，研究对战场进行登记和保护。

en.s: The siege of Toulon took place between 29 July and 21 August 1707 during the War of the Spanish Succession, when a combined Savoyard-Imperial army supported by a British naval force, attacked the French base at Toulon. The Allies had insufficient men to institute a formal siege, while they were outnumbered by French land forces; after losing around 13,000 men, mostly from disease, they retreated to Piedmont.

zh.s: 西班牙王位继承战争期间，萨伏依—帝国联军在英国海军支援下，于1707年7月29日至8月21日进攻法国在土伦的基地。联军兵力不足，无法正式围城，而且人数少于法军陆军；约1.3万人伤亡，其中大多数死于疾病后，联军撤退至皮埃蒙特。

en.s: The siege of Corfu took place on 8 July – 21 August 1716, when the Ottoman Empire besieged the city of Corfu, on the namesake island, then held by the Republic of Venice. The siege was part of the Seventh Ottoman–Venetian War, and, coming in the aftermath of the lightning conquest of the Morea by the Ottoman forces in the previous year, was a major success for Venice, representing its last major military success and allowing it to preserve its rule over the Ionian Islands.

zh.s: 1716年7月8日至8月21日，奥斯曼帝国围攻科孚岛上的科孚城，当时该城由威尼斯共和国控制。这场围城战属于第七次奥斯曼—威尼斯战争。此前一年，奥斯曼军队迅速征服摩里亚；此役则是威尼斯的一次重大胜利，也是其最后一次重大军事胜利，使威尼斯得以保住对爱奥尼亚群岛的统治。

en.s: Battle of Makwanpur was fought on 21 August 1762 in Makwanpurgadhi, Nepal between the Gorkha Kingdom and the Kingdom of Makwanpur. The battle lasted for about eight hours and resulted in Gorkhali victory. 60 Gorkhali and 400 Makwanpur soldiers were killed in the battle.

zh.s: 1762年8月21日，廓尔喀王国与马克万普尔王国在尼泊尔马克万普尔加迪交战。战斗持续约8小时，最终廓尔喀军获胜。廓尔喀军有60人、马克万普尔军有400人阵亡。

en.s: The Battle of Tsaritsyn was decisive confrontation between the Imperial Russian Army, commanded by Johann von Michelsohnen, and serf rebels, led by Yemelyan Pugachev. After Pugachev's victory in the Kazan, Michelsohnen was tasked with the suppression of the revolt, which occurred on August 21, 1774, near Tsaritsyn although the rebels outnumbered his forces. Afterward, the rebellion quickly collapsed.

zh.s: 察里津战役是约翰·冯·米歇尔松指挥的俄罗斯帝国军队与叶梅利扬·普加乔夫率领的农奴叛军之间的一场决定性战斗。普加乔夫在喀山获胜后，米歇尔松奉命镇压叛乱。1774年8月21日，双方在察里津附近交战，尽管叛军人数占优。此后，叛乱迅速瓦解。

en.s: The siege of Pondicherry was the first military action on the Indian subcontinent following the declaration of war between Great Britain and France in the American Revolutionary War. A British force besieged the French Indian port of Pondicherry in August 1778, which capitulated after ten weeks of siege.

zh.s: 本地治里围城战是美国独立战争期间英法宣战后，印度次大陆上的首次军事行动。1778年8月，一支英军围攻法属印度港口本地治里。该港口在遭到十周围攻后投降。

en.s: The Haitian Revolution, also known as the Haitian War of Independence, was a successful insurrection by enslaved Africans against French colonial rule in Saint-Domingue, now the sovereign state of Haiti. The revolution was one of the only known slave rebellions in human history that led to the founding of a state which was both free from slavery (though not from forced labour) and ruled by former captives. Vincent Ogé's 1790 revolt by free Mulattoes (of mixed French and African ancestry) pressured the French Revolutionary government to grant them citizenship in May 1791, leading to further clashes with slave owners that destabilized Saint-Domingue and led to the slave revolt on 21 August 1791, which ended with the former colony's independence on 1 January 1804, with the ex-slave Toussaint Louverture emerging as its most prominent general.

zh.s: 海地革命又称海地独立战争，是圣多明各（今海地）被奴役的非洲人反抗法国殖民统治并取得成功的一场起义。这是已知少数最终建立国家的奴隶起义之一；新国家废除了奴隶制（但仍存在强迫劳动），并由曾被奴役的人统治。1790年，文森特·奥热领导自由混血人群（有法国和非洲血统）发动起义，迫使法国革命政府于1791年5月给予他们公民身份。此后他们与奴隶主冲突加剧，使圣多明各局势动荡，并引发了1791年8月21日的奴隶起义。前殖民地于1804年1月1日独立，曾被奴役的杜桑·卢维杜尔成为最著名的将领。

en.s: In the Battle of Vimeiro (21 August 1808) the British under General Arthur Wellesley (later known as the Duke of Wellington) defeated the French under Major-General Jean-Andoche Junot near the village of Vimeiro (Portuguese pronunciation: [viˈmɐjɾu]), near Lisbon, Portugal during the Peninsular War. This battle put an end to the first French invasion of Portugal. Four days after the Battle of Roliça, Wellesley's army was attacked by a French army under General Junot near the village of Vimeiro. The battle began as a battle of manoeuvre, with French troops attempting to outflank the British left, but Wellesley was able to redeploy his army to face the assault.

zh.s: 半岛战争期间，1808年8月21日，阿瑟·韦尔斯利将军（后来的威灵顿公爵）率领英军在葡萄牙里斯本附近的维梅鲁村击败了让-安多什·朱诺少将率领的法军。这场战斗结束了法国对葡萄牙的首次入侵。罗利萨战役四天后，朱诺将军率领的法军在维梅鲁村附近袭击了韦尔斯利的军队。战斗开始时，法军试图绕到英军左翼后方，韦尔斯利及时重新部署部队迎击。

en.s: The Battle of Karstula was fought between Swedish and Russian troops on August 21, 1808. The Swedish force under Otto von Fieandt was defeated by a much bigger Russian force under Yegor Vlastov. During the battle and retreat the Swedes lost 313 men, the Russians lost 245.

zh.s: 1808年8月21日，瑞典军队与俄军在卡尔斯图拉交战。奥托·冯·菲安特率领的瑞典部队被叶戈尔·弗拉斯托夫指挥的俄军击败，后者兵力远多于瑞典军。战斗和撤退期间，瑞典军损失313人，俄军损失245人。

en.s: Charles XIV John (Swedish: Karl XIV Johan; 26 January 1763 – 8 March 1844) was King of Sweden and Norway from 1818 until his death in 1844 and the first monarch of the Bernadotte dynasty. In Norway, he is known as Charles III John (Norwegian: Karl III Johan); before he became royalty in Sweden, his name was Jean-Baptiste Jules Bernadotte.

zh.s: 卡尔十四世·约翰（瑞典语：Karl XIV Johan；1763年1月26日—1844年3月8日）于1818年至1844年去世前担任瑞典和挪威国王，是贝尔纳多特王朝的首位君主。在挪威，他被称为卡尔三世·约翰（挪威语：Karl III Johan）；成为瑞典王室成员之前，他名叫让-巴蒂斯特·儒勒·贝尔纳多特。

en.s: Nat Turner's Rebellion, historically known as the Southampton Insurrection, was a slave rebellion that took place in Southampton County, Virginia, United States, in August 1831. Led by Nat Turner, the rebels, made up of enslaved African Americans, killed an estimated 55 White people, making it the deadliest slave revolt in U.S. history.

zh.s: 纳特·特纳起义，历史上称为南安普敦起义，是1831年8月发生在美国弗吉尼亚州南安普敦县的一场奴隶起义。起义者由纳特·特纳领导，主要是被奴役的非裔美国人，估计杀害了55名白人，是美国历史上死亡人数最多的奴隶起义。

en.s: The Battle of Portada de Guías (Spanish: Batalla de Portada de Guías), also known as the Battle of Guía (Spanish: Batalla de Guía) or Battle of Piñonate (Spanish: Batalla de Piñonate), took place between the Chilean Army and the secessionist Peruvian Republic in 1838, during the War of the Confederation.

zh.s: 吉亚门战役（西班牙语：Batalla de Portada de Guías），又称吉亚战役（西班牙语：Batalla de Guía）或皮尼奥纳特战役（西班牙语：Batalla de Piñonate），发生于1838年秘鲁—玻利维亚邦联战争期间，交战双方为智利军队和脱离邦联的秘鲁共和国。

en.s: The Third Battle of Taku Forts (Chinese: 第三次大沽口之戰) was an engagement of the Second Opium War, part of the British and French 1860 expedition to China. It took place at the Taku Forts (also called Peiho Forts) near Tanggu District (Wade-Giles: Pei Tang-Ho), approximately 60 kilometers (36 mi.) southeast of the city of Tianjin (Tientsin).

zh.s: 大沽口第三次战役（中文：第三次大沽口之戰）是第二次鸦片战争中的一场战斗，属于1860年英法联军侵华行动的一部分。战斗发生在塘沽区附近的大沽口炮台（又称白河炮台），距天津东南约60公里。

en.t: The Stadtpark, the first public park in Vienna, opens to the public
en.s: The Stadtpark (German: [ˈʃtatˌpaʁk] , City Park) in Vienna, Austria is a large municipal park that extends from the Ringstraße in the Innere Stadt first district up to the Heumarkt (Hay Market) in the Landstraße third district. The park is divided in two sections by the Wienfluss (Vienna River), and has a total surface area of 65,000 square metres (28 acres).

zh.t: 维也纳首座公共公园市立公园向公众开放
zh.s: 维也纳市立公园（德语：Stadtpark，意为“城市公园”）位于奥地利维也纳，从内城第一区的环城大道延伸至第三区兰德施特拉瑟的海市集（Heumarkt）。维也纳河从公园中流过，将它分成两部分。公园总面积为65,000平方米（28英亩）。

en.s: The skirmish near Brooklyn, Kansas was a skirmish of the American Civil War on August 21, 1863, between Quantrill's Raiders and pursuing Union forces immediately after the Lawrence massacre. James Henry Lane led a small group of survivors of the massacre in pursuit of Quantrill's men, and were joined by a force of about 200 Union Army cavalrymen, commanded by Major Preston B. Plumb.

zh.t: 堪萨斯州布鲁克林附近遭遇战
zh.s: 1863年8月21日，劳伦斯大屠杀后不久，昆特里尔突击队与追击他们的联邦军在堪萨斯州布鲁克林附近发生遭遇战。詹姆斯·亨利·莱恩率领一小队大屠杀幸存者追击昆特里尔的人，后来约200名联邦军骑兵加入，由普雷斯顿·B·普拉姆少校指挥。

en.s: The Second Battle of Chattanooga took place during the American Civil War, beginning on August 21, 1863, as the opening battle in the Chickamauga Campaign. The larger and more famous battles were the Battles for Chattanooga (generally referred to as the Battle of Chattanooga) in November 1863.

zh.s: 美国内战期间，第二次查塔努加战役于1863年8月21日打响，是奇克莫加战役的首场战斗。规模更大、知名度更高的查塔努加战役则发生在1863年11月，通常称为查塔努加战役。

en.s: The Lawrence Massacre (also known as Quantrill's Raid) was an attack during the American Civil War (1861–65) by Quantrill's Raiders, a Confederate guerrilla group led by William Quantrill, on the Unionist town of Lawrence, Kansas, killing around 150 men and boys. The attack, on the morning of Friday August 21, 1863, targeted Lawrence due to the town's long support of abolition and its reputation as a center for the Jayhawkers, who were free-state militia and vigilante groups known for attacking plantations in pro-slavery Missouri's western counties.

zh.s: 美国内战期间（1861—65年），威廉·昆特里尔领导的邦联游击队“昆特里尔突击队”袭击了支持联邦的堪萨斯州劳伦斯镇，约150名男性和男孩遇害。这次袭击也称昆特里尔突袭，发生于1863年8月21日星期五早晨。袭击目标是劳伦斯镇，因为该镇长期支持废奴运动，并以“杰霍克”组织活动中心而闻名；这些组织是自由州民兵和治安团体，曾以袭击支持奴隶制的密苏里州西部县份的种植园著称。

en.s: The Battle of Summit Point, also known as Flowing Springs or Cameron's Depot, was an inconclusive battle of the American Civil War fought on August 21, 1864, near Summit Point, West Virginia. The battle was part of Union Maj. Gen. Philip Sheridan's Shenandoah Valley Campaign, which took place between August and December 1864. While Sheridan concentrated his army near Charles Town, Confederate Lt. Gen. Jubal A. Early and Maj. Gen. Richard H. Anderson attacked the Union forces with converging columns on August 21. Anderson struck north against the Union cavalry at Summit Point.

zh.s: 萨米特波因特战役又称弗洛温泉战役或卡梅伦车站战役，是美国内战中的一场未分胜负的战斗，于1864年8月21日在西弗吉尼亚州萨米特波因特附近进行。战斗属于联邦军菲利普·谢里登少将的谢南多厄谷战役，该战役从1864年8月持续至12月。当谢里登在查尔斯镇附近集结部队时，邦联军中将朱巴尔·A·厄利和少将理查德·H·安德森于8月21日分兵合击联邦军。安德森向北攻击萨米特波因特的联邦骑兵。

en.s: The Second Battle of Memphis was a battle of the American Civil War occurring on August 21, 1864, in Shelby County, Tennessee.At 4:00 a.m. on August 21, 1864, Maj. Gen. Nathan Bedford Forrest made a daring raid on Union-held Memphis, Tennessee, but it was not an attempt to capture the city, which was occupied by 6,000 Federal troops. The raid had three objectives: to capture three Union generals posted there; to release Southern prisoners from Irving Block Prison; and to cause the recall of Union forces from Northern Mississippi. Striking northwestward for Memphis with 2,000 cavalry, Forrest lost about a quarter of his strength because of exhausted horses.

zh.s: 第二次孟菲斯战役是美国内战中的一场战斗，于1864年8月21日在田纳西州谢尔比县发生。当天凌晨4时，内森·贝德福德·福雷斯特少将突袭了由联邦军控制的田纳西州孟菲斯，但并未试图占领这座由6000名联邦军士兵驻守的城市。突袭有三个目标：抓捕驻扎当地的三名联邦军将领、释放欧文街区监狱中的南方邦联战俘，以及促使联邦军从密西西比州北部撤回部队。福雷斯特率2000名骑兵向西北进军孟菲斯，但马匹疲惫使他损失了约四分之一的兵力。

en.s: The Cretan revolt of 1866–1869 (Greek: Κρητική Επανάσταση του 1866) or Great Cretan Revolution (Μεγάλη Κρητική Επανάσταση) was a three-year uprising in Crete against Ottoman rule, the third and largest in a series of Cretan revolts between the end of the Greek War of Independence in 1830 and the establishment of the independent Cretan State in 1898.

zh.s: 1866年至1869年的克里特起义（希腊语：Κρητική Επανάσταση του 1866），又称“大克里特革命”（Μεγάλη Κρητική Επανάσταση），是克里特岛反抗奥斯曼统治的一场持续三年的起义。在1830年希腊独立战争结束至1898年克里特自治国成立期间的一系列克里特起义中，这是第三次也是规模最大的一次。

en.t: The American Bar Association is founded in Saratoga Springs, New York
en.s: The American Bar Association (ABA) is a voluntary national bar association of lawyers and law students in the United States, and not specific to any single jurisdiction. Founded in 1878, the ABA's stated activities are the setting of academic standards for law schools, and the formulation of model ethical codes related to the legal profession. As of fiscal year 2017, the ABA had 194,000 dues-paying members, constituting approximately 24.4% of American attorneys.

zh.t: 美国律师协会在纽约州萨拉托加泉成立
zh.s: 美国律师协会（ABA）是美国律师和法学院学生自愿参加的全国性律师组织，不隶属于任何单一司法辖区。协会成立于1878年，所述活动包括制定法学院学术标准，以及拟定与法律职业相关的示范伦理规范。按2017财年数据，ABA有194,000名缴纳会费的会员，约占美国律师总数的24.4%。

en.s: General elections to the Cortes Generales were held in Spain on 21 August 1881. At stake were all 392 seats in the Congress of Deputies. Though formally competitive, the 1881 general election was held under the recently developed system of Turno Pacifico; in accordance with a semi-formal power-sharing arrangement brokered by Antonio Cánovas del Castillo, elections (under influence by machine bosses called caciques) served as a rubber stamp for a routine handover of power initiated by the King. The 1881 election, as expected, sanctioned the pre-arranged handover from the Conservatives to the Liberals.

zh.s: 西班牙于1881年8月21日举行议会选举，选出众议院全部392名议员。虽然选举形式上有竞争，但此次选举按照新近形成的“和平轮替”制度举行。安东尼奥·卡诺瓦斯·德尔卡斯蒂略促成了一项非正式的权力分享安排；在被称为“酋长”的地方势力操控下，选举只是为国王主导的例行权力交接背书。正如预期，1881年选举确认了事先安排好的保守党向自由党的权力交接。

en.s: On August 21, 1883, a violent and devastating tornado affected southeastern portions of the U.S. state of Minnesota. The massive tornado, retrospectively estimated to have been an F5 on the modern Fujita scale, caused at least 37 deaths and over 200 injuries. The tornado was part of a tornado family, a series of tornadoes produced by a supercell, that included at least two significant tornadoes across Southeast Minnesota on August 21.

zh.s: 1883年8月21日，一场猛烈且破坏力极强的龙卷风袭击了美国明尼苏达州东南部。按现代藤田级数追溯估算，这场大型龙卷风达到F5级，造成至少37人死亡、200多人受伤。它属于一组由超级单体雷暴产生的龙卷风，当天明尼苏达州东南部至少出现了两场严重龙卷风。

en.s: The Battle of Concón was fought between the forces of the Congress of Chile and loyalists of President Jose Manuel Balmaceda. In mid-August 1891 the rebel forces were embarked at Iquique, numbering in all about 9,000 men, and sailed for the south. The expedition by sea was admirably managed, and on August 10 the congressist army was disembarked at Quintero, about 20 km. north of Valparaiso, miles out of range of its defensive batteries, and marched to Concón, where the Balmacedists were entrenched.

zh.s: 孔孔战役的交战双方是智利国会军和总统何塞·曼努埃尔·巴尔马塞达的支持者。1891年8月中旬，约9000名叛军在伊基克登船南下。海上行动安排得十分顺利。8月10日，国会军在瓦尔帕莱索以北约20公里的金特罗登陆，远离瓦尔帕莱索的防御炮台射程，随后向巴尔马塞达支持者驻守的孔孔进军。

en.s: The Battle of Charleroi (French: Bataille de Charleroi), or the Battle of the Sambre, was fought on 21 August 1914, by the French Fifth Army and the German 2nd and 3rd armies, during the Battle of the Frontiers. The French were planning an attack across the Sambre River, when the Germans attacked first, forced back the French from the river and nearly cut off the French retreat by crossing the Meuse around Dinant and getting behind the French right flank. The French were saved by a counter-attack at Dinant and the re-direction of the 3rd Army to the north-west in support of the 2nd Army, rather than south-west.

zh.s: 沙勒罗瓦战役（法语：Bataille de Charleroi），又称桑布尔河战役，于1914年8月21日在边境战役期间爆发，交战双方是法国第五集团军和德国第二、第三集团军。法军原计划渡过桑布尔河发动进攻，但德军抢先出击，将法军从河边击退，并在迪南附近渡过默兹河，绕到法军右翼后方，差点切断法军退路。迪南的反击，以及德国第三集团军改向西北支援第二集团军而非向西南推进，挽救了法军。

en.s: The Battle of Laï began on 21 August 1914 in Chad, during the First World War at the village of Laï, capital of the district of Logone, on the Logone River in the south. A German column from Kamerun, led by Captain Von Duhring, attacked the village of Laï, defended by Captain Jeanjean. After a bitter fight, the French were driven out and the village was occupied by the Germans until 1 September 1914.

zh.s: 第一次世界大战期间，莱伊战役于1914年8月21日在乍得南部洛贡区首府莱伊村爆发，该村位于洛贡河畔。冯·杜林上尉率领一支来自喀麦隆的德军纵队进攻由让让上尉防守的莱伊村。经过激战，法军被击退，德军占领该村直到1914年9月1日。

en.s: The Battle of Scimitar Hill (Turkish: Yusufçuk Tepe Muharebesi, lit. 'Battle of the Dragonfly Hill') was the last offensive mounted by the British at Suvla during the Battle of Gallipoli in World War I. It was also the largest single-day attack ever mounted by the Allies at Gallipoli, involving three divisions. The purpose of the attack was to remove the immediate Ottoman threat from the exposed Suvla landing and to link with the ANZAC sectors to the south. Launched on 21 August 1915 to coincide with the simultaneous attack on Hill 60, it was a costly failure, in which the Turks were forced to use all their reserves in "severe and bloody fighting" far into the night, with some Turkish trenches lost and retaken twice.

zh.s: 第一次世界大战加里波利战役期间，英军在苏弗拉发动的最后一次攻势就是弯刀山战役。该战役也是盟军在加里波利发动过的规模最大的一日攻势，出动了三个师。英军希望消除奥斯曼军队对暴露在外的苏弗拉登陆点的直接威胁，并与南面的澳新军团阵地会合。攻势于1915年8月21日发动，与对60号高地的同步进攻相配合，但以惨重失败告终。激烈而血腥的战斗持续到深夜，土军被迫投入全部预备队，部分战壕曾两度易手。

en.s: The Battle of Sari Bair (Turkish: Sarı Bayır Harekâtı), also known as the August Offensive (Ağustos Taarruzları), represented the final attempt made by the British in August 1915 to seize control of the Gallipoli peninsula from the Ottoman Empire during the First World War. At the time of the battle, the Gallipoli Campaign had raged on two fronts – Anzac and Helles – for three months since the Allied land invasion of 25 April 1915.

zh.s: 第一次世界大战期间，萨里拜尔战役（土耳其语：Sarı Bayır Harekâtı）又称八月攻势（Ağustos Taarruzları），是英军1915年8月从奥斯曼帝国手中夺取加里波利半岛控制权的最后一次尝试。战役发生时，盟军自1915年4月25日登陆后，已在安扎克和赫勒斯两条战线上作战三个月。

en.s: The Second Brusilov offensive took place in July–August 1916 on the Eastern Front during the First World War. As a result of the First Brusilov offensive in May–June 1916, the Imperial Russian army defeated the Austro-Hungarian troops and captured a large number of prisoners (up to 50% of the soldiers of the Austro-Hungarian army were of Slavic origin and did not want to fight against the Russian Empire).

en.s: The Second Battle of the Somme of 1918 was fought during the First World War on the Western Front from late August to early September, in the basin of the River Somme. It was part of a series of successful counter-offensives in response to the German Spring Offensive, after a pause for redeployment and supply.
en.n: World War I: The Second Battle of the Somme begins.

zh.s: 1918年第二次索姆河战役是第一次世界大战西线战事的一部分，于8月下旬至9月上旬在索姆河流域进行。此前德军发动春季攻势，盟军经过重新部署和补给后发起一系列反攻，此役是其中之一并取得成功。

en.s: The Battle of Przasnysz took place on August 21, 1920, near the towns of Przasnysz and Ciechanow, during the Polish-Soviet War. Polish forces of Lida Rifle Regiment and 202. Infantry Regiment clashed with elements of Red Army’s 16th and 23rd Infantry Divisions. After the victorious battle of the Wkra river, units of Polish 5th Army (General Wladyslaw Sikorski), began their assault towards Przasnysz and Mlawa (August 18). Soviet 4th Army, which at that time occupied positions along the lower Vistula river, found itself in a difficult situation. As a result, on August 20 General Mikhail Tukhachevsky ordered his troops to concentrate in the area Ciechanow - Przasnysz - Makow Mazowiecki.

zh.s: 波苏战争期间，普拉斯尼什战役于1920年8月21日在普拉斯尼什和切哈努夫两镇附近爆发。波兰利达步枪团和第202步兵团与红军第16、第23步兵师的部分部队交战。克拉河战役获胜后，波兰第五集团军（瓦迪斯瓦夫·西科尔斯基将军）于8月18日开始向普拉斯尼什和姆瓦瓦推进。当时部署在维斯瓦河下游的苏联第四集团军处境困难。8月20日，米哈伊尔·图哈切夫斯基将军因此命令部队集中到切哈努夫—普拉斯尼什—马库夫马佐维茨基一带。

en.s: The Battle of the Tenaru, sometimes called the Battle of the Ilu River or the Battle of Alligator Creek, was a land battle between the Imperial Japanese Army and Allied ground forces that took place on August 21, 1942 on the island of Guadalcanal during the Pacific campaign of World War II. The battle was the first major Japanese land offensive during the Guadalcanal campaign. In the battle, U.S. Marines, under the overall command of U.S. Major General Alexander Vandegrift, repulsed an assault by the "First Element" of the "Ichiki" Regiment, under the command of Japanese Colonel Kiyonao Ichiki.

zh.s: 第二次世界大战太平洋战场的瓜达尔卡纳尔岛战役期间，日军与盟军地面部队于1942年8月21日在瓜达尔卡纳尔岛爆发陆战。这场战斗有时也称为伊鲁河战役或短吻鳄溪战役，是瓜达尔卡纳尔岛战役期间日军首次发动的大规模陆上攻势。战斗中，在美国少将亚历山大·范德格里夫特统一指挥下的美国海军陆战队，击退了日本一木清直大佐指挥的一木支队“先遣队”攻势。

en.s: Federal elections were held in Australia on 21 August 1943. All 74 seats in the House of Representatives, and 19 of the 36 seats in the Senate were up for election. The incumbent Australian Labor Party led by Prime Minister of Australia John Curtin defeated the opposition Country Party led by Arthur Fadden and coalition partner the United Australia Party led by Billy Hughes. Although the UAP was the nominal senior partner in the Coalition and had been in government since 1931, it found itself bereft of leadership following the forced resignation of its leader, Robert Menzies.

zh.s: 澳大利亚于1943年8月21日举行联邦选举。众议院全部74个席位和参议院36个席位中的19个席位进行改选。由澳大利亚总理约翰·柯廷领导的执政党澳大利亚工党击败了由阿瑟·法登领导的反对党乡村党，以及由比利·休斯领导的联合政府伙伴联合澳大利亚党。联合澳大利亚党名义上是联合政府中的主要政党，自1931年以来一直执政，但该党领袖罗伯特·孟席斯被迫辞职后，党内失去了领导人。

en.s: The Bombing of Wewak was a series of air raids by the USAAF Fifth Air Force, on 17–21 August 1943, against the major air base of the Imperial Japanese Army Air Force on the mainland of New Guinea, at Wewak. The four raids, over a five-day period, represented a decisive victory for the Allies: the Japanese Fourth Air Army lost about 170 planes on the ground and in the air, reducing its operational strength to about 30 planes.

en.s: In August 1991, hardliners of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union (CPSU) attempted to forcibly seize control of the country from Mikhail Gorbachev, who was Soviet president and General Secretary of the CPSU at the time. The coup leaders consisted of top military and civilian officials, including Vice President Gennady Yanayev, who together formed the State Committee on the State of Emergency (Russian: ГКЧП, romanized: GKChP). Opposed to Gorbachev's reform program, they were angry at the loss of control over Eastern European states and fearful of the New Union Treaty, which was on the verge of being signed by the Soviet Union (USSR). The treaty was to decentralize much of the central Soviet government's power and distribute it among its fifteen republics. Boris Yeltsin's demand for more autonomy to the republics opened a window for the plotters to organize the coup. The attempt took place between 19 and 21 August 1991; as a result, the events were referred to as the August Coup.

en.s: Latvia, officially the Republic of Latvia, is a country in the Baltic region of northern Europe. en.s: On August 21, 1995, Atlantic Southeast Airlines Flight 529, an Embraer EMB 120 Brasilia flying from Atlanta, Georgia, to Gulfport, Mississippi, crashed in the community of Burwell between the cities of Bowdon, Georgia, and Carrollton, Georgia. en.s: The PGA Championship (often referred to as the US PGA Championship or USPGA outside the United States) is an annual golf tournament conducted by the Professional Golfers' Association of America. en.s: SummerSlam (2005) was the eighteenth annual SummerSlam professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE). It was presented by THQ's WWE Day of Reckoning 2 and took place on August 21, 2005, at the MCI Center in Washington, D.C. featured talent from the Raw and SmackDown! brands. The main match on the Raw brand was Hulk Hogan versus Shawn Michaels, which Hogan won by pinfall after executing a leg drop. The predominant match on the SmackDown brand was a No Holds Barred match for the World Heavyweight Championship between Batista and John "Bradshaw" Layfield (JBL), which Batista won by pinfall after executing two Batista Bombs, with the second on the steel ring steps.

en.s: A federal election was held on Saturday, 21 August 2010 for members of the 43rd Parliament of Australia. en.s: The Ghouta chemical attack occurred in Ghouta, Syria, during the Syrian Civil War in the early hours of 21 August 2013. Two opposition-controlled areas in the suburbs around Damascus, Syria were struck by rockets containing the chemical agent sarin. Estimates of the death toll range from at least 281 people to 1,729. The attack was the deadliest use of chemical weapons since the Iran–Iraq War. Inspectors from the United Nations Mission already in Syria to investigate an earlier alleged chemical weapons attack, requested access to sites in Ghouta the day after the attack, and called for a ceasefire to allow inspectors to visit the Ghouta sites.

zh.s: 叙利亚内战期间，2013年8月21日凌晨，叙利亚古塔发生化学袭击。大马士革郊区两个由反对派控制的地区遭到装有沙林毒剂的火箭弹袭击。死亡人数估计至少281人，最高可达1729人。这是两伊战争以来最致命的一次化学武器袭击。联合国调查团当时已在叙利亚调查此前一起疑似化学武器袭击，事发次日要求进入古塔的相关地点，并呼吁停火以便调查人员前往现场。

en.t: West Midlands Police and Crime Commissioner by-election, 2014
en.s: The West Midlands Police and Crime Commissioner by-election, 2014 was a by-election for the position of Police and Crime Commissioner in the West Midlands Police region of the United Kingdom, held on 21 August 2014. It was triggered by the death of Bob Jones, the inaugural West Midlands Police and Crime Commissioner, who died on 1 July 2014. The election had to be held with 35 working days of the vacancy by virtue of Section 51 of the Police Reform and Social Responsibility Act 2011. On 4 July 2014, Birmingham City Council, who oversaw the election, confirmed that the poll would be held on 21 August 2014.

en.s: SummerSlam (2016) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event and WWE Network event produced by WWE. It took place on August 21, 2016 at the Barclays Center in Brooklyn, New York. It was the twenty-ninth event under the SummerSlam chronology, the second consecutive SummerSlam at this particular venue, and the first event under the reintroduction of the WWE brand extension. Twelve matches were contested at the event, including three matches contested on the pre-show. In the main event, Brock Lesnar defeated Randy Orton by technical knockout while in other marquee matches, Finn Bálor defeated Seth Rollins to become the inaugural WWE Universal Champion, Dean Ambrose defeated Dolph Ziggler to retain the WWE World Championship, and AJ Styles defeated John Cena.

zh.s: 2016年夏日狂潮大赛是WWE举办的一场职业摔角按次付费赛事，也在WWE Network播出。比赛于2016年8月21日在纽约布鲁克林的巴克莱中心举行，是夏日狂潮系列第29届赛事，也是该场馆连续第二年举办这项赛事。这是WWE重新引入品牌分拆后的首场赛事，共进行了12场比赛，其中3场在赛前举行。主赛中，布洛克·莱斯纳以技术性击倒击败兰迪·奥顿。其他重点比赛中，芬·巴洛尔击败塞斯·罗林斯，成为首任WWE环球冠军；迪恩·安布罗斯击败多尔夫·齐格勒，成功卫冕WWE世界冠军；AJ·斯泰尔斯击败约翰·塞纳。

en.s: A total solar eclipse, dubbed the "Great American Eclipse" by some media, occurred on Monday, August 21, 2017.
